projects.summary: Agent 原生应用的前端技术栈，为 React/Angular/Vue/React Native 及 Slack/Teams 提供生成式 UI、共享状态和人机协同工作流，AG-UI 协议的提出方。
projects.summary_en: Frontend stack for agent-native apps: generative UI, shared state, and human-in-the-loop workflows for React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Teams. Originator of the AG-UI protocol.

projects.name: khoj-ai/khoj
projects.summary: 自托管的个人 AI 第二大脑，可对接任意本地或在线 LLM，从网络和本地文档中检索答案、创建自定义知识 Agent、定时自动化深度研究，支持浏览器/Obsidian/Emacs/手机/WhatsApp 多入口。
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted personal AI "second brain" that works with any local or online LLM, answers from the web and your documents, builds custom knowledge agents, and schedules automated deep research. Reachable from browser, Obsidian, Emacs, phone, and WhatsApp.

projects.name: karpathy/LLM101n
projects.summary: Andrej Karpathy 发起的教学项目，计划从零手把手（Python/C/CUDA）教你搭建一个类 ChatGPT 的故事生成 LLM，目前该课程仍在由 Eureka Labs 开发中，仓库处于归档状态。
projects.summary_en: Andrej Karpathy's teaching project that plans to walk you through building a ChatGPT-like story-generating LLM from scratch (Python/C/CUDA). The course is still in development at Eureka Labs and the repo is archived.

projects.name: musistudio/claude-code-router
projects.summary: 本地控制面板，把 Claude Code、Codex、Grok CLI、Kimi CLI 等编码 Agent 与任意模型供应商连接起来，统一路由、故障转移、扩展能力并观测每一次请求。
projects.summary_en: Local control panel that connects coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Grok CLI, and Kimi CLI to any model provider, with unified routing, failover, extensibility, and observability of every request.

projects.name: LAION-AI/Open-Assistant
projects.summary: LAION 发起的开源聊天助手项目，目标是让所有人都能用上高质量对话式大模型，项目已于 2023 年完结，产出的 oasst2 数据集仍在 HuggingFace 开放。
projects.summary_en: LAION's open-source chat-assistant project, aiming to give everyone access to a high-quality conversational LLM. Concluded in 2023; its oasst2 dataset remains open on HuggingFace.

projects.name: AlexsJones/llmfit
projects.summary: 命令行硬件适配工具，检测你的 CPU/内存/GPU/显存配置，推荐能在本机流畅跑的开源 LLM 及量化方案，并可把实测 token/s 提交回项目共享给其他人参考。
projects.summary_en: Command-line hardware-fit tool that detects your CPU, RAM, GPU, and VRAM, recommends open-source LLMs and quantizations that run smoothly on your machine, and lets you submit measured tokens/s back to share with others.

projects.name: PDFMathTranslate/PDFMathTranslate
projects.summary: 保留排版的科学 PDF 双语翻译工具（EMNLP 2025 Demo），支持公式、图表、目录、批注完整保留，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero 多种接入方式，对接 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等翻译服务。
projects.summary_en: Layout-preserving bilingual translation for scientific PDFs (EMNLP 2025 demo), keeping formulas, figures, tables of contents, and annotations intact. Offers CLI, GUI, MCP, Docker, and Zotero access, and connects to translation services such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI.

projects.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
projects.summary: Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，收录内部插件与经审核的第三方插件，用 /plugin install 一键安装。
projects.summary_en: Anthropic-maintained directory of Claude Code plugins, including first-party plugins and vetted third-party ones, installable in one step with /plugin install.

projects.name: songquanpeng/one-api
projects.summary: LLM API 统一管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI/Azure/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/文心一言/通义千问等主流模型，单可执行文件、Docker 一键部署，用于 key 管理和二次分发。
projects.summary_en: Unified LLM API management and distribution system supporting OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, ERNIE Bot, Tongyi Qianwen, and other mainstream models. A single executable with one-step Docker deployment, used for key management and secondary distribution.

projects.name: ItzCrazyKns/Vane
projects.summary: 隐私优先、完全自托管的 AI 问答搜索引擎（原 Perplexica），支持本地 Ollama 与 OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/Groq 等云端模型，基于 SearxNG 聚合多搜索引擎并标注信息来源。
projects.summary_en: Privacy-first, fully self-hosted AI answer engine (formerly Perplexica). Supports local Ollama and cloud models such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Groq, and aggregates multiple search engines through SearxNG with cited sources.

projects.name: sgl-project/sglang
projects.summary: 高性能 LLM/多模态模型推理服务框架，Day-0 支持 DeepSeek-V4/Kimi K3 等最新开源模型，在 NVIDIA GB300 等新硬件上做推理性能优化。
projects.summary_en: High-performance serving framework for LLMs and multimodal models, with day-0 support for the latest open models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Kimi K3 and inference optimization on new hardware such as NVIDIA GB300.

projects.name: VectifyAI/PageIndex
projects.summary: 无向量数据库的推理式 RAG，把文档索引成层级树结构，让 LLM 像人类专家一样逐层“推理检索”而非单纯语义相似度匹配，专为长篇专业文档设计。
projects.summary_en: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG: indexes documents into a hierarchical tree so an LLM can "reason its way through retrieval" layer by layer like a human expert instead of relying on semantic similarity alone. Built for long professional documents.

projects.name: gitroomhq/postiz-app
projects.summary: 开源社媒排期与自动化工具，可通过 ChatGPT/Claude/Claude Code/Codex/Cursor 等 AI Agent 直接驱动发布，提供 Node SDK 和 n8n/Make.com 集成。
projects.summary_en: Open-source social-media scheduling and automation tool that AI agents such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can drive directly. Offers a Node SDK and n8n/Make.com integrations.

projects.name: reworkd/AgentGPT
projects.summary: 早期知名的浏览器端自主 Agent 项目，输入一个目标即可配置、部署自主 AI Agent，自动拆解任务、执行并从结果中学习。
projects.summary_en: Early well-known in-browser autonomous agent: enter a goal to configure and deploy an autonomous AI agent that breaks down tasks, executes them, and learns from the results.

projects.name: microsoft/graphrag
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的模块化图谱式检索增强生成系统，通过构建知识图谱提升复杂问答场景下的检索质量。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's modular graph-based retrieval-augmented generation system, building a knowledge graph to improve retrieval quality for complex question answering.

projects.name: continuedev/continue
projects.summary: 开源编码 Agent，可接入 IDE 或终端，支持自定义模型和规则，帮助开发者在保留控制权的前提下把 AI 编码能力集成进现有工作流。
projects.summary_en: Open-source coding agent for IDEs and the terminal, with custom models and rules, helping developers bring AI coding into existing workflows while keeping control.

projects.name: linshenkx/prompt-optimizer
projects.summary: AI 提示词优化工具，支持网页、桌面、Chrome 插件、Docker 四种形态，把手写/模板/本地导入的提示词进行优化、测试、评估并沉淀为可复用资产。
projects.summary_en: AI prompt-optimization tool available as a web app, desktop app, Chrome extension, and Docker image. Optimizes, tests, and evaluates handwritten, templated, or imported prompts and saves them as reusable assets.

projects.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
projects.summary: 面向终端的 DeepSeek 原生编码 Agent，围绕 prefix-cache 稳定性设计、可长时间挂机运行，单一 Go 二进制，支持终端/桌面/浏览器/编辑器（ACP）四种接入方式。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek-native coding agent for the terminal, designed around prefix-cache stability and long unattended runs. A single Go binary with four access modes: terminal, desktop, browser, and editor (ACP).

projects.name: lightpanda-io/browser
projects.summary: 从零用 Zig 写的专为 AI Agent 和自动化设计的无头浏览器，非 Chromium/WebKit 分支，内存占用降到 Chromium 的 1/16、速度快 9 倍。
projects.summary_en: Headless browser written from scratch in Zig for AI agents and automation. Not a Chromium/WebKit fork; uses 1/16 of Chromium's memory and runs 9x faster.

projects.name: agentscope-ai/QwenPaw
projects.summary: 个人 AI 助理，易于本地或云端部署，三层记忆架构（工作上下文/完整历史/自进化知识库）、内置沙箱与工具/文件安全防护，支持多 Agent 并行与跨系统通信协议 ACP。
projects.summary_en: Personal AI assistant that is easy to deploy locally or in the cloud. Three-tier memory (working context, full history, self-evolving knowledge base), built-in sandbox and tool/file safeguards, parallel multi-agent execution, and the ACP cross-system communication protocol.

projects.name: lyogavin/airllm
projects.summary: 极致显存优化的大模型推理库，通过分层流式加载让 70B 模型在 4GB 显卡上跑起来，支持 Kimi K3（2.8T 参数）、DeepSeek-V3 等超大模型的单卡推理与训练。
projects.summary_en: Extreme memory-optimized LLM inference library: layer-by-layer streaming lets a 70B model run on a 4GB GPU. Supports single-GPU inference and training of very large models such as Kimi K3 (2.8T parameters) and DeepSeek-V3.

projects.name: langfuse/langfuse
projects.summary: 开源 LLM 应用可观测性与评测平台，追踪、评估、改进 AI 应用的一站式工具，可分钟级自托管，被 ClickHouse 收购后持续商业化运营。
projects.summary_en: Open-source LLM application observability and evaluation platform: one place to trace, evaluate, and improve AI apps, self-hostable in minutes. Continues to operate commercially after being acquired by ClickHouse.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
projects.summary: 精选（非 AI 批量生成）的官方团队 Agent Skills 合集，收录 Claude、VoltAgent、Supabase、Stripe、Google Gemini 等团队发布的真实技能，兼容 Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Gemini CLI 等。
projects.summary_en: Curated (not AI-bulk-generated) collection of Agent Skills from official teams, including real skills published by Claude, VoltAgent, Supabase, Stripe, Google Gemini, and others. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more.

projects.name: qdrant/qdrant
projects.summary: Rust 编写的高性能向量数据库与搜索引擎，支持混合检索、多租户过滤，并提供官方 Agent Skills 让编码 Agent 直接做量化/分片等向量检索工程决策。
projects.summary_en: High-performance vector database and search engine written in Rust, with hybrid search and multi-tenant filtering, and official Agent Skills that let coding agents make vector-search engineering decisions such as quantization and sharding.

projects.name: OpenBMB/ChatDev
projects.summary: ChatDev 2.0，通过 LLM 驱动的多智能体协作模拟一个虚拟软件公司（CEO/CTO/程序员/测试等角色）来完成软件开发全流程。
projects.summary_en: ChatDev 2.0: simulates a virtual software company (CEO, CTO, programmers, testers, and other roles) through LLM-driven multi-agent collaboration to complete the whole software-development process.

projects.name: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
projects.summary: 个人交易 Agent，一条命令即可为 Agent 装备完整的量化交易能力，支持回测、多 Agent 协作和 MCP 接入。
projects.summary_en: Personal trading agent: one command equips an agent with full quantitative-trading capabilities, including backtesting, multi-agent collaboration, and MCP access.

projects.name: datawhalechina/happy-llm
projects.summary: Datawhale 出品的系统性 LLM 教程，从 NLP 基础一路讲到手搭 LLaMA2、预训练/SFT/LoRA 微调全流程，直到 Agentic RL（GRPO/Search-R1/ReTool）。
projects.summary_en: Systematic LLM tutorial from Datawhale: from NLP basics through hand-building LLaMA2, pre-training, SFT, and LoRA fine-tuning, all the way to agentic RL (GRPO, Search-R1, ReTool).

projects.name: SillyTavern/SillyTavern
projects.summary: 面向重度玩家的本地 LLM 前端，统一对接 KoboldAI/NovelAI/OpenAI/Claude 等几乎所有文本生成后端，支持视觉小说模式、图像生成、TTS、World Info 角色设定和海量第三方扩展。
projects.summary_en: Local LLM front end for power users, connecting to nearly every text-generation backend (KoboldAI, NovelAI, OpenAI, Claude, and more), with visual-novel mode, image generation, TTS, World Info character setups, and a huge library of third-party extensions.

projects.name: TabbyML/tabby
projects.summary: 自托管 AI 编码助手，GitHub Copilot 的开源本地替代品，自包含无需数据库/云服务，支持消费级 GPU，正在孵化 Agent 私测版 Pochi。
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted AI coding assistant, an open-source local alternative to GitHub Copilot. Self-contained with no database or cloud service needed, runs on consumer GPUs, and is incubating a private-beta agent, Pochi.

projects.name: can1357/oh-my-pi
projects.summary: Stencil Labs 出品、fork 自 Pi 的编码 Agent，深度集成 IDE 能力，支持 60+ 模型供应商、31 种内置工具、14 种 LSP 操作，核心用 Rust 实现。
projects.summary_en: Coding agent from Stencil Labs, forked from Pi, with deep IDE integration, 60+ model providers, 31 built-in tools, and 14 LSP operations. Core implemented in Rust.

projects.name: openai/codex-plugin-cc
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方出品的 Claude Code 插件，让你在 Claude Code 里直接调用 Codex 做代码评审或委派任务，提供 /codex:review 等命令，需要 ChatGPT 订阅或 OpenAI API Key。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's Claude Code plugin that lets you call Codex from inside Claude Code for code review or delegated tasks, with commands such as /codex:review. Requires a ChatGPT subscription or an OpenAI API key.

projects.name: Pythagora-io/gpt-pilot
projects.summary: 早期知名的“AI 全自动开发者”项目，能从需求描述自主写代码；⚠️ 仓库 2025-08~2026-06 期间曾被植入窃取凭据的供应链蠕虫恶意代码，已于 2026-06-11 清除，若在此期间克隆并运行过需立即轮换凭据。
projects.summary_en: Early well-known "fully autonomous AI developer" that writes code on its own from a description. ⚠️ Between August 2025 and June 2026 the repo was injected with credential-stealing supply-chain worm code, removed on 2026-06-11; if you cloned and ran it during that window, rotate your credentials immediately.

projects.name: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
projects.summary: 面向 AI Agent 的网络安全技能库，818 个技能覆盖 34 个安全领域，映射 MITRE ATT&CK/NIST CSF 等 6 大框架，社区项目，与 Anthropic 官方无关联，仅限授权测试使用。
projects.summary_en: Cybersecurity skill library for AI agents: 818 skills across 34 security domains, mapped to six frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF. A community project unaffiliated with Anthropic, for authorized testing only.

projects.name: Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex
projects.summary: 面向 OpenAI Codex CLI 的工作流增强层，加钩子、Agent 团队、HUD 等能力，与同作者的 oh-my-claudecode 同源。
projects.summary_en: Workflow enhancement layer for the OpenAI Codex CLI, adding hooks, agent teams, a HUD, and more. Shares its origin with the same author's oh-my-claudecode.

projects.name: mckaywrigley/chatbot-ui
projects.summary: 早期知名的开源 ChatGPT 界面替代品，支持任意模型的 AI 聊天客户端。
projects.summary_en: Early well-known open-source ChatGPT UI alternative: an AI chat client that works with any model.

projects.name: alchaincyf/nuwa-skill
projects.summary: 把任意人物的思维方式（心智模型、决策启发式、表达风格）蒸馏成可复用 Agent 技能，输入一个名字自动完成调研、提炼、验证全流程，兼容 50+ Agent 运行时。
projects.summary_en: Distills anyone's way of thinking (mental models, decision heuristics, expression style) into a reusable agent skill. Give it a name and it runs research, distillation, and validation automatically; compatible with 50+ agent runtimes.

projects.name: github/github-mcp-server
projects.summary: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，让 AI Agent 直接读写仓库代码、管理 Issue/PR、分析 CI/CD 构建、查看安全告警，支持远程托管和本地两种接入方式。
projects.summary_en: GitHub's official MCP server that lets AI agents read and write repository code, manage issues and PRs, analyze CI/CD builds, and view security alerts. Available as a hosted remote server or run locally.

projects.name: iOfficeAI/AionUi
projects.summary: 开源 24/7 Cowork 应用，统一管理 OpenClaw、Hermes、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 20+ 命令行 Agent，可自定义并组队多个助理协同工作。
projects.summary_en: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app that manages 20+ command-line agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more) in one place, with customizable assistants that can be teamed up to work together.

projects.name: huggingface/agents-course
projects.summary: Hugging Face 官方 Agent 课程，4 个单元从 Agent/LLM 基础讲到函数调用微调，免费开放注册学习。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's official agents course: four units from agent and LLM fundamentals to function-calling fine-tuning, free to enroll.

projects.name: virgiliojr94/book-to-skill
projects.summary: 把任意技术书籍 PDF 或文档合集转换成统一的 Claude Code 技能，供随时查阅和使用，官方测算比直接把书塞进上下文节省 24-51 倍 token。
projects.summary_en: Converts any technical-book PDF or document set into a unified Claude Code skill you can consult anytime. Its own measurements show 24-51x fewer tokens than stuffing the book into context.

projects.name: zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw
projects.summary: 用 Rust 编写、编译成单一二进制的个人 Agent 运行时，对接 Anthropic/OpenAI/Ollama 等 20 多个模型提供商，通过 Discord、Telegram、Matrix、邮件、语音、Webhook 等 30+ 渠道接入，工具能力覆盖 shell、浏览器、HTTP、硬件和自定义 MCP server，全部运行在用户自己的机器上。
projects.summary_en: Personal agent runtime written in Rust and compiled to a single binary. Connects to 20+ model providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama, and is reachable through 30+ channels including Discord, Telegram, Matrix, email, voice, and webhooks. Tools cover shell, browser, HTTP, hardware, and custom MCP servers, all running on the user's own machine.

projects.name: vercel-labs/skills
projects.summary: Vercel 官方出品的开放 Agent Skills 生态 CLI（npx skills），支持从 GitHub/GitLab/Azure Repos 等来源安装技能，兼容 75+ 种 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Vercel's CLI for the open Agent Skills ecosystem (npx skills): installs skills from GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, and other sources, and works with 75+ agents.

projects.name: agentscope-ai/agentscope
projects.summary: 生产级易用的 Agent 框架 2.0，强调发挥模型自身推理和工具使用能力而非用死板提示词强行编排，支持团队流水线、模型路由等能力。
projects.summary_en: Production-ready, easy-to-use agent framework (v2.0) that emphasizes leveraging the model's own reasoning and tool use instead of forcing rigid prompt orchestration. Supports team pipelines, model routing, and more.

projects.name: p-e-w/heretic
projects.summary: 全自动移除语言模型“安全对齐”审查的工具，基于方向性消融技术加 Optuna 参数优化，无需重新训练即可解除大多数稠密/MoE 模型的拒答行为。
projects.summary_en: Fully automatic tool that removes the "safety alignment" censorship from language models, using directional ablation plus Optuna parameter optimization to lift refusals in most dense and MoE models without retraining.

projects.name: datawhalechina/self-llm
projects.summary: 《开源大模型食用指南》，面向中文初学者的 Linux 环境快速部署/微调开源大模型教程，覆盖 LLaMA、ChatGLM、InternLM 等主流模型的环境配置、部署和高效微调全流程。
projects.summary_en: An open-source LLM "user's guide" for Chinese-speaking beginners: quick deployment and fine-tuning of open-source models on Linux, covering environment setup, deployment, and efficient fine-tuning for LLaMA, ChatGLM, InternLM, and other mainstream models.

projects.name: onyx-dot-app/onyx
projects.summary: 开源 AI 聊天平台，作为团队和 AI Agent 的统一知识/上下文层，连接 50+ 应用索引企业知识，支持自托管部署、网页搜索、沙箱和技能扩展。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI chat platform serving as a unified knowledge and context layer for teams and AI agents: indexes enterprise knowledge from 50+ apps, self-hostable, with web search, sandboxes, and skill extensions.

projects.name: davila7/claude-code-templates
projects.summary: Claude Code 配置与监控 CLI 工具（aitmpl.com），提供大量现成的 Agent/命令/Hook/MCP 配置模板，一键安装。
projects.summary_en: Claude Code configuration and monitoring CLI (aitmpl.com) offering many ready-made agent, command, hook, and MCP configuration templates, installable in one step.

projects.name: Fincept-Corporation/FinceptTerminal
projects.summary: 对标彭博终端的开源金融分析应用，提供市场行情、投资研究、多智能体 AI 研究桌面等功能，核心开源免费、企业版收费。
projects.summary_en: Open-source financial analysis app modeled on the Bloomberg Terminal, with market data, investment research, and a multi-agent AI research desktop. Core is free and open source; an enterprise edition is paid.

projects.name: hsliuping/TradingAgents-CN
projects.summary: 基于多智能体 LLM 的中文 A 股研究辅助系统，多个分析师角色辩论式协作完成个股研究、自然语言选股和模拟交易，仅供学习不构成投资建议。
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent LLM research assistant for Chinese A-shares: analyst roles debate and collaborate on stock research, natural-language stock screening, and simulated trading. For learning only, not investment advice.

projects.name: linexjlin/GPTs
projects.summary: 收集泄露的各类自定义 GPTs 系统提示词合集，涵盖角色扮演、翻译、学习辅导等数十种场景。
projects.summary_en: Collection of leaked system prompts from custom GPTs, covering dozens of scenarios such as role-play, translation, and tutoring.

projects.name: tirth8205/code-review-graph
projects.summary: 本地优先的代码知识图谱，用 Tree-sitter 构建结构化代码地图并增量更新，通过 MCP 给 AI 编码工具提供精确的评审上下文，减少重复读取大段代码。
projects.summary_en: Local-first code knowledge graph built with Tree-sitter that updates incrementally and gives AI coding tools precise review context through MCP, reducing repeated reads of large chunks of code.

projects.name: lbjlaq/Antigravity-Manager
projects.summary: Antigravity 账号管理与协议中转工具，一键切换多账号、把 Web Session 转成标准 API 接口，用 Tauri v2 + React 构建。
projects.summary_en: Antigravity account manager and protocol relay: switch between multiple accounts in one click and turn a web session into a standard API. Built with Tauri v2 and React.

projects.name: CloakHQ/CloakBrowser
projects.summary: 源码级修改指纹的隐身版 Chromium，可无缝替换 Playwright/Puppeteer，用于让 AI Agent 浏览器自动化绕过反爬/反机器人检测（Cloudflare Turnstile 等）。
projects.summary_en: Stealth Chromium with source-level fingerprint changes, a drop-in replacement for Playwright/Puppeteer, used to let AI agents' browser automation get past anti-bot and anti-scraping checks such as Cloudflare Turnstile.

projects.name: feder-cr/invisible_playwright_mcp
projects.summary: 不被反爬虫和验证码检测到的 Playwright MCP 服务器，让 AI Agent 用隐身版 Firefox 浏览网页、做自动化抓取和调研。
projects.summary_en: Playwright MCP server that evades anti-bot and CAPTCHA detection, letting AI agents browse, scrape, and research through a stealth Firefox.

projects.name: vercel-labs/agent-skills
projects.summary: Vercel 官方 Agent Skills 合集，包含 Vercel 项目成本/性能审计、React/Next.js 性能规范、Web 设计规范等技能，遵循开放 Agent Skills 格式。
projects.summary_en: Vercel's official Agent Skills collection, including Vercel project cost and performance audits, React/Next.js performance guidelines, and web design guidelines, following the open Agent Skills format.

projects.name: hesamsheikh/awesome-openclaw-usecases
projects.summary: 社区收集的 OpenClaw 真实使用案例合集，覆盖社媒摘要、账号分析、自动化发帖等场景，提醒引用的第三方技能/插件未经审计需自行评估安全性。
projects.summary_en: Community-collected real-world OpenClaw use cases, covering social-media digests, account analytics, automated posting, and more. Warns that the third-party skills and plugins referenced are unaudited, so assess their safety yourself.

projects.name: BigPizzaV3/CodexPlusPlus
projects.summary: 面向 OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT 桌面应用的外部启动器和管理工具，提供供应商切换、协议转换、会话管理和界面增强，不修改官方应用本体。
projects.summary_en: External launcher and manager for the OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT desktop apps, offering provider switching, protocol conversion, session management, and UI enhancements without modifying the official app.

projects.name: stanford-oval/storm
projects.summary: 斯坦福出品的 LLM 知识策展系统，输入一个主题即可自动研究并生成带引用的完整报告，EMNLP/NAACL 论文成果，已集成 litellm 支持多模型。
projects.summary_en: Stanford's LLM knowledge-curation system: give it a topic and it researches and writes a full cited report. An EMNLP/NAACL paper result, now integrated with litellm for multi-model support.

projects.name: ScrapeGraphAI/Scrapegraph-ai
projects.summary: 用 LLM 加图逻辑构建抓取流水线的 Python 网页爬虫库，说出想要提取的信息，库会自动处理网页/本地文档（XML/HTML/JSON/Markdown）解析。
projects.summary_en: Python web-scraping library that builds scraping pipelines with an LLM plus graph logic: say what information you want and it handles parsing of web pages and local documents (XML/HTML/JSON/Markdown) automatically.

projects.name: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
projects.summary: 首个专为 AI Agent 设计的 Office 套件命令行工具，无需安装 Office 即可读写 Word/Excel/PowerPoint，内置 HTML/PNG 渲染引擎让 Agent“看到”文档效果并纠错。
projects.summary_en: The first Office-suite command-line tool designed for AI agents: reads and writes Word, Excel, and PowerPoint with no Office installation, and a built-in HTML/PNG renderer lets agents "see" the document and fix mistakes.

projects.name: getzep/graphiti
projects.summary: 面向 AI Agent 的实时时序知识图谱框架，持续追踪事实随时间的变化并保留数据溯源，比传统 RAG 更适合处理不断演变的真实世界数据。
projects.summary_en: Real-time temporal knowledge-graph framework for AI agents that tracks how facts change over time while preserving provenance, better suited than classic RAG to evolving real-world data.

projects.name: Zackriya-Solutions/meetily
projects.summary: 隐私优先的 AI 会议助手，基于 Rust 用 Parakeet/Whisper 做本地实时转录、说话人分离，再用 Ollama 生成会议纪要，100% 本地处理。
projects.summary_en: Privacy-first AI meeting assistant written in Rust: local real-time transcription with Parakeet/Whisper and speaker diarization, then meeting minutes generated with Ollama. Processing is 100% local.

projects.name: googleworkspace/cli
projects.summary: 统一的 Google Workspace 命令行工具（Drive/Gmail/Calendar/Sheets 等），从 Google Discovery Service 动态生成命令并内置 40+ Agent 技能，README 明确声明非 Google 官方产品。
projects.summary_en: Unified command-line tool for Google Workspace (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, etc.) that generates commands dynamically from the Google Discovery Service and ships with 40+ agent skills. The README states clearly that it is not an official Google product.

projects.name: topoteretes/cognee
projects.summary: 开源 AI 记忆平台，把文档、代码、对话转成自托管知识图谱供 Agent 检索复用，可用免费小模型在 CPU 上本地跑，无需 API Key。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI memory platform that turns documents, code, and conversations into a self-hosted knowledge graph for agents to retrieve and reuse. Can run locally on a CPU with a small free model and no API key.

projects.name: Tencent/WeKnora
projects.summary: 腾讯官方出品的开源 LLM 知识平台，把原始文档变成可查询的 RAG、自主推理 Agent 和自维护 Wiki 三合一系统，支持从 ClawHub/SkillHub 安装技能扩展 Agent 工具箱。
projects.summary_en: Tencent's open-source LLM knowledge platform that turns raw documents into a three-in-one system of queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining wiki. Supports installing skills from ClawHub/SkillHub to extend the agent's toolbox.

projects.name: supermemoryai/supermemory
projects.summary: AI 记忆与上下文引擎，在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo、ConvoMem 三大权威基准上排名第一，95% 召回率、99.4% 上下文压缩率，可完全本地运行。
projects.summary_en: AI memory and context engine ranked first on three major benchmarks (LongMemEval, LoCoMo, ConvoMem), with 95% recall and 99.4% context compression. Can run fully locally.

projects.name: nanocoai/nanoclaw
projects.summary: 定位为 OpenClaw 的轻量替代品，每个 Agent 运行在独立容器里做操作系统级隔离；作者认为 OpenClaw 代码量太大（近 50 万行、70+ 依赖）难以审计，NanoClaw 用一个进程加几个文件实现同等核心功能，并为 Slack 场景提供“一个 Agent 一个 Slack App”的开箱配置。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw that runs each agent in its own container for OS-level isolation. The author argues OpenClaw is too large to audit (nearly 500,000 lines, 70+ dependencies); NanoClaw delivers the same core with one process and a few files, and offers a ready-made "one agent, one Slack app" setup for Slack.

projects.name: ComposioHQ/composio
projects.summary: 给 AI Agent 提供 1000+ 预授权工具箱的平台，含按用户会话管理、鉴权、触发器和沙箱，支持 OpenAI Agents、Claude Agent SDK、LangChain 等主流框架的适配器。
projects.summary_en: Platform that gives AI agents 1000+ pre-authorized toolkits, with per-user session management, auth, triggers, and sandboxes. Ships adapters for OpenAI Agents, Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, and other major frameworks.

projects.name: e2b-dev/awesome-ai-agents
projects.summary: AI 自主 Agent 项目合集，区分开源项目与闭源产品/公司两部分，由 E2B（Code Interpreter 服务商）维护。
projects.summary_en: Collection of autonomous AI agent projects, split into open-source projects and closed-source products/companies, maintained by E2B (a code-interpreter provider).

projects.name: sipeed/picoclaw
projects.summary: 硬件厂商 Sipeed 用 Go 从零打造的超轻量个人 AI 助理，10 美元硬件、10MB 内存即可运行，比 OpenClaw 省 99% 内存，非任何项目的 fork。
projects.summary_en: Ultra-light personal AI assistant written from scratch in Go by hardware maker Sipeed: runs on $10 hardware with 10 MB of memory, using 99% less memory than OpenClaw. Not a fork of any project.

projects.name: decolua/9router
projects.summary: 免费 AI 路由与 token 节省工具，把 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等编码工具接到 40+ 免费/低价模型供应商，自动故障转移并压缩工具输出节省 20-40% token。
projects.summary_en: Free AI routing and token-saving tool that connects coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to 40+ free or low-cost model providers, with automatic failover and tool-output compression that saves 20-40% of tokens.

projects.name: zarazhangrui/frontend-slides
projects.summary: 编码 Agent 技能，用“展示而非描述”的方式生成 HTML 网页演示文稿，支持从 PowerPoint 转换，内置反 AI 套路的视觉风格库，打包成 Claude Code 插件。
projects.summary_en: Coding-agent skill that generates HTML web presentations in a "show, don't tell" style, with PowerPoint conversion and a built-in anti-AI-cliché visual style library, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

projects.name: oraios/serena

projects.summary_en: Powerful coding MCP toolkit offering symbol-level semantic code retrieval, editing, and refactoring (close to an IDE), plugged into any client or LLM through MCP so agents work faster and more reliably in large codebases.

projects.name: langchain-ai/deepagents

projects.summary_en: LangChain's "batteries-included" agent harness built on LangGraph, with sub-agents, a pluggable filesystem, context management, human-in-the-loop, and skill loading. Model-agnostic.

projects.name: labring/FastGPT
projects.summary: 基于 LLM 的知识库 Agent 构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索和可视化工作流编排，支持云端和自托管部署，中国团队 labring 出品。
projects.summary_en: LLM-based knowledge-base agent-building platform with out-of-the-box data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual workflow orchestration. Supports cloud and self-hosted deployment; from the Chinese team labring.

projects.name: openai/openai-agents-python
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方出品的轻量级多智能体工作流框架，供应商无关，支持 OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions 及 100+ 其他 LLM，内置 Agent、沙箱 Agent 和实时 Agent 三类核心概念。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's lightweight multi-agent workflow framework. Provider-agnostic, supporting OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions and 100+ other LLMs, with three core concepts built in: agents, sandbox agents, and realtime agents.

projects.name: simstudioai/sim
projects.summary: 协作式工作空间，用于构建、部署和监控 AI Agent 与工作流，号称被 10 万+开发者使用。
projects.summary_en: Collaborative workspace for building, deploying, and monitoring AI agents and workflows, claiming 100,000+ developers.

projects.name: assafelovic/gpt-researcher
projects.summary: 自主深度研究 Agent，支持任意 LLM 供应商，对任意主题做规划、检索、自我校验后生成带引用的详细研究报告，受 Plan-and-Solve 和 RAG 论文启发。
projects.summary_en: Autonomous deep-research agent that works with any LLM provider. Plans, retrieves, and self-verifies on any topic, then writes a detailed, cited research report. Inspired by the Plan-and-Solve and RAG papers.

projects.name: aishwaryanr/awesome-generative-ai-guide
projects.summary: 生成式 AI 一站式资源仓库，按“使用 AI / 构建 AI / 理解研究 / 面试准备”四条路径组织课程、论文、面试题和笔记本。
projects.summary_en: One-stop generative-AI resource repo organized along four paths: use AI, build AI, understand the research, and prepare for interviews. Includes courses, papers, interview questions, and notebooks.

projects.name: NirDiamant/RAG_Techniques
projects.summary: 42+ 个可运行 Notebook 教程，系统讲解从基础到前沿的 RAG 技术实现原理和代码，社区驱动的教学项目。
projects.summary_en: 42+ runnable notebook tutorials that systematically explain RAG techniques from basics to the frontier, with principles and code. A community-driven teaching project.

projects.name: JushBJJ/Mr.-Ranedeer-AI-Tutor
projects.summary: 早期知名的 GPT-4 个性化 AI 家教 Prompt，可按用户需求定制学习深度和风格，项目现已停止维护（标注 DISCONTINUED）。
projects.summary_en: Early well-known GPT-4 personalized AI-tutor prompt that lets users tailor learning depth and style. No longer maintained (marked DISCONTINUED).

projects.name: huggingface/smolagents
projects.summary: Hugging Face 官方出品的极简 Agent 库，核心逻辑约 1000 行代码，主打“用代码而非 JSON 写行动”的 CodeAgent，支持沙箱执行和 Hub 分享。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's minimalist agent library: the core logic is about 1,000 lines, centered on a CodeAgent that writes actions as code rather than JSON, with sandboxed execution and Hub sharing.

projects.name: ahujasid/mcp-for-blender
projects.summary: 社区插件，让任意 LLM 通过 MCP 控制 Blender 3D 做建模、场景搭建和操作，非 Blender 官方出品。
projects.summary_en: Community plugin that lets any LLM control Blender 3D through MCP for modeling, scene building, and operations. Not an official Blender product.

projects.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
projects.summary: 聚合 34 个免费 LLM 供应商、635 个免费模型端点的网关，统一走一个 OpenAI 兼容 /v1 接口，智能路由加自动故障转移，仅限个人实验使用。
projects.summary_en: Gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers and 635 free model endpoints behind one OpenAI-compatible /v1 interface, with smart routing and automatic failover. For personal experimentation only.

projects.name: chroma-core/chroma
projects.summary: 开源 AI 数据基础设施，专注检索/向量数据库，核心 API 仅 4 个函数即可上手，也提供托管的 Chroma Cloud 服务。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI data infrastructure focused on retrieval and vector search. The core API is just four functions, and a hosted Chroma Cloud service is also available.

projects.name: anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop

projects.summary_en: Desktop client for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin ecosystem, wrapping a local web UI, host service, and plugin system in a native app. An independent community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

projects.name: HandsOnLLM/Hands-On-Large-Language-Models

projects.summary_en: Official code repo for the O'Reilly book Hands-On Large Language Models, with nearly 300 custom illustrations explaining practical LLM tools and concepts.

projects.name: Nutlope/hallmark

projects.summary_en: "Anti-AI-cliché" design skill from Together AI: 21 visual themes plus 57 anti-sameness checks so interfaces generated by Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex stop looking like generic AI output.

projects.name: alibaba/page-agent

projects.summary_en: Official Alibaba in-page GUI agent: a snippet of JavaScript gives any web page its own AI agent. Works by manipulating the text DOM rather than screenshots, and connects to any LLM, including locally deployed ones.

projects.name: meta-llama/llama3

projects.name: rohitg00/agentmemory

projects.summary_en: Persistent memory tool for coding agents, using confidence scoring, lifecycle management, and hybrid knowledge-graph retrieval. Supports Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and other mainstream tools.

projects.name: voideditor/void

projects.summary_en: Open-source AI editor built as a VS Code fork, positioned against Cursor. The project recently announced it is deprecated and no longer maintained, but remains open source as a reference for building your own VS Code fork.

projects.name: harvard-edge/cs249r_book
projects.summary: 哈佛大学 CS249r 课程教材《机器学习系统》，涵盖基础到 Agentic AI、物理 AI 等前沿内容，多语言翻译开放阅读。
projects.summary_en: Textbook for Harvard's CS249r course, Machine Learning Systems, covering fundamentals through agentic AI and physical AI. Free to read, with multilingual translations.

projects.name: microsoft/semantic-kernel

projects.name: firecrawl/open-lovable

projects.summary_en: Demo app from the Firecrawl team that clones and rebuilds any website as a modern React app in seconds, showing what Firecrawl scraping plus an LLM can do.

projects.name: yamadashy/repomix
projects.summary: 把整个代码仓库打包成单一 AI 友好文件的工具，方便把代码库喂给 Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Gemini 等任意 LLM 分析。
projects.summary_en: Packs an entire code repository into a single AI-friendly file, making it easy to feed a codebase to any LLM for analysis, such as Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, or Gemini.

projects.name: srbhr/Resume-Matcher
projects.summary: AI 简历优化工具，支持 100+ 本地/云端 LLM，上传简历和职位描述后生成针对性改进建议、求职信和面试准备。
projects.summary_en: AI resume-optimization tool supporting 100+ local and cloud LLMs: upload a resume and a job description to get targeted improvement suggestions, a cover letter, and interview prep.

projects.name: mastra-ai/mastra

projects.summary_en: Modern full-stack TypeScript framework for AI apps and agents, with model routing (40+ providers), agents, a graph-based workflow engine, and human-in-the-loop. From a YC-backed team.

projects.name: charmbracelet/crush

projects.summary_en: Terminal coding agent from the Charm team. Works with any LLM (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs), keeps multi-session context, adds LSP enhancement and MCP extensions, and runs on nearly every terminal platform.

projects.name: Budibase/budibase

projects.summary_en: Open-source operations platform that uses AI agents, apps, and automations instead of hand-building internal tools. Model-agnostic; employees can send requests straight to an agent for automatic handling.

projects.name: OtterMind/Chat2DB

projects.summary_en: Cross-platform, local-first database client and SQL workbench supporting 40+ databases, which can connect to your own AI models to generate, explain, and optimize SQL in natural language.

projects.name: jarrodwatts/claude-hud

projects.name: BloopAI/vibe-kanban

projects.summary_en: Open-source terminal coding agent from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team, with Auto-Memory, Auto-Skills, and sub-agent teams. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Qwen protocols as well as local models.

projects.name: mlflow/mlflow

projects.name: google-labs-code/design.md

projects.name: h4ckf0r0day/obscura

projects.name: eyaltoledano/claude-task-master

projects.summary_en: Task-management system for AI-driven development that plugs into Cursor, Lovable, Windsurf, Roo, and any other AI coding tool, providing task breakdown and tracking over MCP.

projects.name: PrefectHQ/fastmcp

projects.name: manaflow-ai/cmux

projects.summary_en: macOS terminal built on Ghostty with vertical tabs and notifications designed for AI coding agents, making it easy to run and manage many agent sessions in parallel.

projects.name: openai/symphony

projects.name: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory

projects.name: Hannibal046/Awesome-LLM

projects.name: OthmanAdi/planning-with-files

projects.name: deepset-ai/haystack

projects.name: yikart/AiToEarn

projects.name: Cinnamon/kotaemon

projects.summary_en: Specification and documentation repo for the Agent Skills open standard. Defines the SKILL.md format and progressive loading of skills (discovery, then activation); the official source of the agentskills.io standard.

projects.name: enescingoz/awesome-n8n-templates

projects.summary_en: 280+ free n8n automation workflow templates covering Gmail, Telegram, AI agents, RAG chatbots, and more. The largest continuously updated open-source n8n template collection.

projects.summary_en: LLM evaluation and red-teaming CLI/library that compares GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and other models, with declarative config and CI/CD integration. The README says the project has joined OpenAI but remains open source under MIT and independently operated.

projects.name: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios

projects.name: microsoft/OmniParser

projects.name: browserbase/stagehand

projects.summary_en: Browser agent SDK that extracts data and interacts with sites like a human. Login state persists across runs, and observed actions return real selectors so credentials are never leaked to the model.

projects.name: toon-format/toon

projects.summary_en: TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation), a compact serialization format for LLM prompts that combines YAML-style indentation with CSV-style tables, saving more tokens than JSON while keeping structure clear. Offers a TypeScript SDK and a CLI.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents

projects.summary_en: Collection of 161+ Claude Code sub-agents covering 10 categories of development tasks. Explicitly rejects purely promotional PRs to stay vendor-neutral.

projects.name: microsoft/JARVIS

projects.name: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin

projects.summary_en: Official "compound engineering" plugin: 36 skills organized around a brainstorm, plan, build, review, and capture-learnings loop, supporting 14 agent hosts.

projects.name: liguodongiot/llm-action

projects.summary_en: Project sharing LLM theory and hands-on experience, systematically covering LLM training, inference, compression, evaluation, prompt engineering, and LLMOps end to end, with tutorials.

projects.name: titanwings/distilly

projects.summary_en: Skill (formerly Colleague Skill) that distills a person's experience, judgment, and expression style into a reusable "persona" agents and bots can call, for modeling colleagues, family, public figures, and other people.

projects.name: vxcontrol/pentagi

projects.summary_en: Fully autonomous AI-agent penetration-testing system in which multiple agents collaborate on complex security tests. Works with Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other model providers.

projects.name: karpathy/llm-council

projects.summary_en: A small weekend "vibe coding" tool by Karpathy: send a question to several LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok) at once, have them anonymously review and score each other, then let a "chairman model" merge everything into the final answer.

projects.name: Dao-AILab/flash-attention

projects.name: letta-ai/letta

projects.summary_en: The AGENTS.md open format: essentially a "README for agents", a standard convention for giving coding agents project context and operating instructions in one predictable place.

projects.name: karpathy/nn-zero-to-hero

projects.name: pascalorg/editor

Implements the HybridFlow paper, supports algorithms such as GRPO and PPO, and integrates seamlessly with inference and training frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, and Megatron.

projects.name: coleam00/Archon

projects.name: AiHubCN/Awesome-Chinese-LLM
projects.summary: 整理中文开源大语言模型的资源合集，以中小规模、可私有化部署、训练成本较低的模型为主，涵盖底座模型、垂直微调应用和数据集教程，已收录 100+ 资源。
projects.summary_en: Curated collection of open-source Chinese large language models, focused on small and mid-sized models that can be privately deployed at low training cost. Covers base models, vertical fine-tuned applications, and dataset tutorials, with 100+ resources.

projects.name: antirez/ds4
projects.summary: Redis 作者 antirez 打造的 DeepSeek V4/GLM 5.x 等模型本地推理引擎 DwarfStar，主打 Metal/CUDA/ROCm 消费级硬件上运行超大模型，代码库自带专用 GGUF 生成工具。
projects.summary_en: DwarfStar, a local inference engine by Redis author antirez for models such as DeepSeek V4 and GLM 5.x, aimed at running very large models on consumer Metal/CUDA/ROCm hardware. The repo ships its own GGUF generation tooling.

projects.name: HKUDS/AI-Trader
projects.summary: 港大数据智能实验室出品的“Agent 原生交易平台”，任意 AI Agent 均可注册加入实盘/实验交易，用同一套实时行情评分体系排行榜比拼交易能力。
projects.summary_en: "Agent-native trading platform" from HKU's Data Intelligence Lab: any AI agent can register for live or experimental trading and compete on a leaderboard scored against the same real-time market data.

projects.name: NVIDIA/NemoClaw
projects.summary: NVIDIA 官方出品的沙箱化 Agent 运行参考栈，在 NVIDIA OpenShell 里更安全地运行 OpenClaw、Hermes、LangChain Deep Agents 等主流 Agent，提供托管推理和网络策略控制。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's reference stack for running agents in a sandbox: runs OpenClaw, Hermes, LangChain Deep Agents, and other mainstream agents more safely inside NVIDIA OpenShell, with managed inference and network-policy control.

projects.name: winfunc/opcode
projects.summary: Claude Code 可视化 GUI 桌面应用，用 Tauri 构建，支持创建自定义 Agent、管理会话、运行安全的后台 Agent 和 MCP 服务器，独立开发者项目非 Anthropic 官方。
projects.summary_en: Visual GUI desktop app for Claude Code, built with Tauri: create custom agents, manage sessions, and run secure background agents and MCP servers. An independent developer project, not from Anthropic.

projects.name: BuilderIO/gpt-crawler
projects.summary: 抓取网站生成知识文件用于创建自定义 GPT 的工具，输入一个或多个 URL 即可产出可直接上传给 OpenAI 自定义 GPT 的知识库文件。
projects.summary_en: Crawls websites to generate knowledge files for building custom GPTs: give it one or more URLs and it produces a knowledge file you can upload directly to an OpenAI custom GPT.

projects.name: wavetermdev/waveterm
projects.summary: 开源 AI 集成终端，内置能读取终端输出、分析组件并执行文件操作的上下文感知 AI 助手，支持多模型和持久化 SSH 会话。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI-integrated terminal with a context-aware assistant that can read terminal output, analyze components, and perform file operations. Supports multiple models and persistent SSH sessions.

projects.name: yoheinakajima/babyagi
projects.summary: 2023 年 3 月首创任务规划式自主 Agent 概念的里程碑项目，原始版本已归档，当前仓库是实验性的自构建 Agent 框架，作者声明非生产可用。
projects.summary_en: Landmark project that pioneered the task-planning autonomous-agent idea in March 2023. The original version is archived; the current repo is an experimental self-building agent framework, and the author states it is not production-ready.

projects.name: jundot/omlx
projects.summary: 为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理和 SSD 分层 KV 缓存，从 macOS 菜单栏直接管理，让本地大模型服务实际可用于编码等生产场景。
projects.summary_en: LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, with continuous batching and SSD-tiered KV cache, managed from the macOS menu bar, making local model serving practical for coding and other production use.

projects.name: comet-ml/opik
projects.summary: Comet 出品的开源 LLM 可观测性与评测平台，覆盖 Agent 追踪、LLM 评测、Prompt 管理和生产监控，Apache-2.0 协议可完全自托管。
projects.summary_en: Comet's open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform covering agent tracing, LLM evals, prompt management, and production monitoring. Apache-2.0 licensed and fully self-hostable.

projects.name: microsoft/unilm
projects.summary: Microsoft Research 大规模自监督预训练研究代码库，涵盖 BitNet、RetNet、LongNet 等基础架构研究和 Kosmos 系列多模态基座模型。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft Research's large-scale self-supervised pre-training research codebase, covering foundational architecture work such as BitNet, RetNet, and LongNet, and the Kosmos family of multimodal foundation models.

projects.name: PromtEngineer/localGPT
projects.summary: 完全本地运行的私有文档问答平台，混合稠密向量检索和全文检索，配合重排序、智能路由和上下文剪枝，数据完全不出本机。
projects.summary_en: Fully local private document Q&A platform: hybrid dense-vector and full-text retrieval with reranking, smart routing, and context pruning. Data never leaves your machine.

projects.name: firecrawl/anydoc
projects.summary: Firecrawl 官方出品的 Rust 文档转换库，把 Word/PPT/Excel/PDF 等格式秒级转成干净的 Markdown，提供 Node.js/Python/WASM 多语言绑定，是 Firecrawl Parse 服务的底层引擎。
projects.summary_en: Firecrawl's Rust document-conversion library that turns Word, PPT, Excel, PDF, and more into clean Markdown in seconds. Has Node.js, Python, and WASM bindings and is the engine behind the Firecrawl Parse service.

projects.name: joonspk-research/generative_agents
projects.summary: 斯坦福/Google 经典研究论文《Generative Agents》配套代码，25 个具备记忆和社交行为的生成式 Agent 在虚拟小镇“The Ville”里自主生活互动的模拟环境。
projects.summary_en: Companion code for the Stanford/Google paper "Generative Agents": a simulation in which 25 generative agents with memory and social behavior live and interact autonomously in the virtual town "The Ville".
